query:
SELECT 
  ei.evaluationId,
  ei.evaluatedStudentId,
  ei.pontualidade, 
  ei.pesquisa_metas, 
  ei.dominio, 
  ei.participacao, 
  ei.desempenho_papel,
  ei.absent as item_absent,
  e.evaluatorStudentId,
  ss_evaluator.absent as evaluator_absent,
  s_evaluator.name as evaluator_name
FROM evaluation_items ei
JOIN evaluations e ON ei.evaluationId = e.id
JOIN session_students ss_evaluator ON e.evaluatorStudentId = ss_evaluator.id
JOIN students s_evaluator ON ss_evaluator.studentId = s_evaluator.id
WHERE ei.evaluatedStudentId IN (
  SELECT ss.id FROM session_students ss WHERE ss.studentId = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE enrollment = '23211323')
);
